items.title: How BAFTA Albert is driving sustainability across the screen industry
items.summary: Ahead of the Sustainable Supply Chains Summit, event speaker April Sotomayor, the head of industry sustainability at BAFTA Albert, shares how the organisation is helping to drive supply chain action and industry-wide transformation.

items.title: Bristol City Leap to upgrade council buildings with heat pumps
items.summary: Bristol City Leap has announced plans to upgrade heating and energy systems at three council-owned buildings as part of efforts to reduce carbon emissions, cut energy use and improve the resilience of public services.

items.title: Every $1 invested in clean air brings $15 returns, UN finds
items.summary: Released on the International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies (7 September), a new UN report has estimated that coordinated action on climate and air pollution could deliver 15-fold returns.

items.title: NINE DAYS to go until edie’s Sustainable Supply Chains Summit
items.summary: Join us on 17 September for a unique opportunity to gain expert-led insights through thought leadership and industry panels featuring top professionals in sustainability, supply chain and procurement.

items.title: ON THURSDAY: Exploring the role of bio-based materials in lower-carbon buildings
items.summary: Next week, edie is hosting a new webinar exploring the growing interest in bio-based materials.

items.title: NEXT WEEK: Preparing UK businesses for European sustainability reporting requirements
items.summary: With just two weeks to go, edie’s new webinar will explore what the European Sustainability Reporting Standards for Third-Country Groups (ESRS-TC) could mean for UK-headquartered businesses.

items.title: Why courage is the most important competitive advantage for businesses in 2026
items.summary: The companies that will stand out are those willing to act on their values (and say so out loud), argues 1% for the Planet's chief executive, Kate Williams.

items.title: Plastic Overshoot Day: One-third of global plastic waste won’t be properly managed in 2026
items.summary: The amount of plastic waste generated globally in 2026 so far has officially exceeded the world’s capacity to safely manage it, researchers have claimed.

items.title: Water Breakthrough Challenge: £50m ringfenced for projects that combat drought and transform water sector
items.summary: Ofwat has launched the next iteration of its Water Breakthrough Challenge, offering to support up to £50m on a range of collaborative projects that can tackle drought and improve water security.

items.title: Nominations open for edie’s 30 Under 30 Class of 2027
items.summary: edie’s 30 Under 30 is back for 2027, celebrating ambitious young professionals turning sustainability ambition into meaningful action across business.
